title: Client harness outcome line
description: One NDJSON line per scenario on the client harness's stdout. The harness reports what its SDK observed, normalized back to wire JSON via the SDK's own encoder; the runner evaluates expectations. Input lines on stdin are {"scenario": id, "baseUrl": url}.

kind.description: result: op returned, value holds the normalized result. error: SDK surfaced a protocol error, errorCode/errorMessage set. stream: events holds the ordered observed events. card/interface: discovery pseudo-ops. harness-error: the harness itself failed (timeout, crash, decode the SDK could not perform is NOT this — a decode failure the SDK surfaces is kind=error with errorCode null). unsupported: the SDK cannot perform this op (runner reports skip).

value.description: Normalized wire JSON of the decoded result/card/interface.
